map.空气密度 ρ=1.225、速度 v=80 m/s、升力系数 C_L=1.2、面积: Air density ρ=1.225, speed v=80 m/s, lift coefficient C_L=1.2 and area A=30 m². L=½×1.225×80²×1.2×30 = ½×1.225×6400×1.2×30 = 140,688 N ≈ 140.7 kN. Level flight when it just balances a weight of the same order.

map.ρ 用哪个高度的值？: Which altitude value of ρ should be used?
map.用飞行高度的实际空气密度，海平面 ρ≈1.225、巡航高度显著下降。密度低则同速: Use the actual air density at the flight altitude; at sea level ρ≈1.225 and it falls markedly at cruise altitude. Lower density means less lift at the same speed, requiring a higher speed or a larger C_L (large wing area) to compensate.
